nodes.name: agent-env.mjs
nodes.summary: Resolves which ports this checkout uses: every worktree gets a numbered slot that shifts the web/mobile/API base ports so parallel agents never collide. Exports ROOT and agentEnv() consumed by the dev-serve, QA, and worktree scripts; also runnable standalone to print the resolved slot.
nodes.languageNotes: ES module that doubles as a CLI via an argv[1] filename check — a common Node pattern for importable scripts.

nodes.name: agentEnv
nodes.summary: Returns the resolved {slot, web, mobile, api, feUrl, apiUrl} environment for this checkout, honoring explicit PKG_*/QA_* env vars, then .agent.json, then slot 0 defaults.

nodes.name: dev-serve.mjs
nodes.summary: CLI wrapper (`node scripts/dev-serve.mjs web|mobile|api`) that starts the static frontend, the mobile www/ server, or the PHP API server on this checkout's slot-assigned port, since npm scripts cannot portably resolve the slot value.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses `shell: true` only on Windows so cmd.exe can resolve npx/php — a portability guard for cross-platform spawning.

nodes.name: qa-milestone.mjs
nodes.summary: Offline milestone QA harness (`npm run qa:milestone -- Mx`): boots the Laravel API and static frontend on this checkout's slot ports if they are not already up, then runs Playwright specs for every milestone up to the requested one as a regression gate.
nodes.languageNotes: JSON.stringify is used to quote the Playwright config path so checkouts under directories containing spaces survive `shell: true` argv concatenation.

nodes.name: isUp
nodes.summary: Probes a URL with a 1.5s abort-timeout fetch, treating any non-5xx HTTP response as 'up'.

nodes.name: waitFor
nodes.summary: Polls isUp every 500ms for up to 40 attempts, throwing if the server never becomes ready.

nodes.name: startProcess
nodes.summary: Spawns a child process with piped stdio that is echoed only when QA_VERBOSE is set, returning the child handle for later cleanup.

nodes.name: killTree
nodes.summary: Terminates a spawned server, using `taskkill /T /F` on Windows to kill the whole process tree and SIGTERM elsewhere.

nodes.name: runPlaywright
nodes.summary: Runs `npx playwright test` against e2e/playwright.config.js with QA_MILESTONE, QA_API_URL, and QA_FRONTEND_URL propagated, resolving with the child exit code.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Orchestrates the QA run: parses the milestone argument, starts the API (with BILLING_SANDBOX forced) and frontend if missing, collects matching spec files, runs Playwright, reports pass/fail, and kills any servers it started.

nodes.name: worktree.mjs
nodes.summary: CLI to create, list, and safely remove git worktrees for parallel agents — provisions per-worktree npm/composer installs, copies backend .env and the SQLite database, rewrites APP_URL, and assigns a port slot via a gitignored .agent.json file.
nodes.languageNotes: Dependencies are installed per worktree rather than junction-linked because Windows deletion recurses through junctions — a hard-won lesson documented inline.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Executes one install step (npm/composer) inside the new worktree, logging failure without aborting the overall setup.

nodes.name: cmdNew
nodes.summary: Creates a worktree on branch agent/<name> from main, copies backend .env and the SQLite database, rewrites APP_URL to the slot's API port, writes .agent.json, and runs the dependency installs.

nodes.name: cmdList
nodes.summary: Lists every git worktree with its slot, current branch, dirty state, and the web/mobile/API ports assigned to that slot.

nodes.name: cmdRemove
nodes.summary: Removes a worktree only when it has no uncommitted changes and no commits unmerged to main, clearing .agent.json first and giving Windows-specific guidance when a live process holds the directory.

nodes.name: BUG-001-is-admin-not-mass-assignable.md
nodes.summary: QA bug report: `is_admin` was missing from `User::$fillable`, so Laravel silently dropped it during mass assignment — AdminUserSeeder and the admin-privileges checkbox returned 200 but never persisted.

nodes.name: BUG-002-admin-panel-link-disappears.md
nodes.summary: QA bug report: the Admin Panel sidebar link vanished after page load because `/api/user` omitted `is_admin`, so `js/shell.js`'s background refresh re-rendered the sidebar with `isAdmin = false`.

nodes.name: BUG-003-cash-entries-admin-page-broken.md
nodes.summary: QA bug report: the admin Cash Entries page called the non-existent `GET /api/admin/entries` and read `e.kind`/`e.description` instead of the CashEntry model's `type`/`note` fields.

nodes.name: BUG-004-payment-gateway-column-mismatch.md
nodes.summary: QA bug report: payments admin views and AdminController referenced a non-existent `gateway` column — the real `payments` column is `provider`, so the Gateway column rendered blank and the filter would SQL-error.

nodes.name: BUG-005-m11-tests-never-ran.md
nodes.summary: QA bug report: the M11 e2e suite never ran under `qa:milestone` because `e2e/playwright.config.js` had its own hardcoded `MILESTONE_ORDER` ending at M10, silently falling back to running only M1 specs.

nodes.name: BUG-006-admin-tables-xss-and-broken-onclick.md
nodes.summary: QA bug report: admin tables interpolated user text into innerHTML (stored-XSS vector) and built inline onclick handlers with unescaped names, breaking Edit/Delete on names containing apostrophes. Fixed with escapeHtml() and data-* event delegation.

nodes.name: BUG-007-admin-modals-always-visible-and-uncloseable.md
nodes.summary: QA bug report: admin edit/delete modals rendered permanently visible because the author `.admin-modal { display: flex }` rule beat the user-agent `[hidden]` rule at equal specificity; fixed with an explicit `.admin-modal[hidden]` override.

nodes.name: BUG-001-guest-is-redirected-from-cashflow-page-to-login.md
nodes.summary: QA bug report (closed as false positive): `serve` clean-URL rewrites turned `login.html` into `/login`, so the guest-redirect E2E assertion failed even though the redirect itself worked; assertion updated to accept both.

nodes.name: BUG-002-logged-in-user-can-add-an-expense-in-the-ui.md
nodes.summary: QA bug report (closed as false positive): Playwright treats `<option>` elements as not visible by default; fixed the expense-entry test with `toHaveCount` plus `addInitScript` to seed the auth token.

nodes.name: BUG-003-guest-is-redirected-from-cashflow-page-to-login.md
nodes.summary: QA bug report (closed as false positive): same root cause as BUG-001 — the observed URL was `http://127.0.0.1:3000/login` (clean URL); assertion now matches both `/login` and `/login.html`.

nodes.languageNotes: Named `nul`, a Windows reserved device name — likely created by a Unix-style `> nul` redirect that wrote a literal file instead of discarding output.

nodes.name: build-mobile.mjs
nodes.summary: Build step that assembles `www/` — the directory Capacitor copies into the native Android/iOS projects — by plain-copying only the mobile screens, shared web modules (api.js, units.js, cart.js), and assets the app actually loads.
nodes.languageNotes: Deliberately no bundler: ES modules are copied verbatim because Capacitor webviews support them natively. Fails hard on missing sources so a skipped file can't become a 404 inside the APK.

nodes.name: copy
nodes.summary: Copies one file from the repo root into `www/`, throwing if the source is missing so silent omissions can't ship as in-APK 404s.

nodes.name: lint-js.mjs
nodes.summary: Syntax-checks every ES module under `js/` and `mobile/js/` with `node --check`, replacing a hand-maintained per-file chain that silently stopped covering new modules.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure top-level script — no functions; iterates both source roots so a syntax error in mobile/js/ can't hide until it hits a native webview.

nodes.name: test-admin-setup.mjs
nodes.summary: Manual verification script that checks API health, logs in the seeded admin, confirms admin-dashboard access, and verifies a freshly registered non-admin is blocked from admin endpoints.

nodes.name: checkHealth
nodes.summary: GETs `/api/health` and reports whether the Laravel API is reachable, with a hint to start the backend when the connection fails.

nodes.name: loginAdmin
nodes.summary: POSTs the seeded admin credentials to `/api/login`, prints the returned user's email and `is_admin` flag, and returns the bearer token (or null with seeding guidance on 401).

nodes.name: checkAdminAccess
nodes.summary: Calls `GET /api/admin/dashboard` with the admin bearer token and prints the returned stats; treats 403 as an `is_admin`-flag problem.

nodes.name: testNonAdminAccess
nodes.summary: Registers a throwaway user via `/api/register` and asserts the new non-admin token gets 403 from `/api/admin/dashboard`, proving the admin gate rejects regular users.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Orchestrates the verification run — health check, admin login, admin access, non-admin denial — exiting 1 with next-step guidance at the first hard failure and printing setup-complete info on success.

nodes.name: write-bug.mjs
nodes.summary: Bug-report generator used by the offline QA harness: writes a `BUG-NNN-<slug>.md` file under `docs/issues/<MILESTONE>/` from a markdown template and appends a row to the issues index — no AI tokens required.

nodes.name: nextBugId
nodes.summary: Scans a milestone's issues directory for existing `BUG-NNN` filenames and returns the next zero-padded id, creating the directory if needed.

nodes.name: milestoneDocLinks
nodes.summary: Maps a milestone id (M1–M8) to its milestone doc and task-checklist paths for inclusion in the bug file's Links section.

nodes.name: updateIndex
nodes.summary: Appends a bug-entry row to the `docs/issues/README.md` index table, creating the file and table header if missing and skipping duplicates.

nodes.name: writeBug
nodes.summary: Renders and writes a complete bug markdown file (repro steps, expected/actual, evidence, milestone links), strips ANSI codes from failure output, updates the issues index, and returns the new bug id and path.

tour.title: What Is PK Galla Online?
tour.description: Start with the project README and AGENTS.md to understand what this product is: a point-of-sale till plus a khata (udhaar credit ledger) for small Pakistani shops, built as a vanilla HTML/JS frontend on port 3000 talking to a Laravel 12 JSON API on port 8000, with a Capacitor mobile shell. docs/README.md then indexes the milestone history (M1–M35) so you can trace how each feature arrived.

tour.title: The POS Till Page
tour.description: pos.html is the product's heart — the screen a shopkeeper uses all day. It pairs with js/pos.js, which wires the product grid with category filters and search, a weigh pad for measured goods, the cart ticket, day-book open/close gates, and payment methods including udhaar credit. The feature doc docs/features/pos-till.md explains the intended flow end to end.

tour.title: Cart Math, Units & Receipt
tour.description: Digging into the till's helpers: js/cart.js is a pure cart model handling line items, quantities, totals and change due — deliberately free of DOM code so it is unit-testable. js/units.js implements the kiryana pack's base-unit model (pc/g/ml) so goods can be priced by weight or by rupee amount, and js/receipt.js renders the printable sale slip with paper-width handling.
tour.languageLesson: Keeping the cart as a pure model (data in, totals out, no DOM access) is what lets the Node test runner exercise till arithmetic without a browser — a pattern worth copying for any business-logic module.

tour.title: Frontend Plumbing: API Client & Shell
tour.description: Every authenticated page shares the same plumbing. js/api.js is the fetch-based client for the Laravel API — it resolves the base URL, stores the Sanctum bearer token, exposes verb helpers, and renders the subscription-lapsed gate screen. js/shell.js builds the sidebar app shell with permission-aware navigation, and js/theme.js (fan-in 29) applies the shared light/dark theme to every page.

tour.title: Laravel API Entry & Routes
tour.description: Cross to the backend: backend/public/index.php is the Laravel front controller that loads the Composer autoloader and boots the application kernel. Everything it serves is mapped in backend/routes/api.php — throttled auth and Google OAuth endpoints, then a Sanctum-protected, subscription-gated group covering POS sales, khata customers, purchases, reports and admin. backend/README.md documents setup and the endpoint reference.

tour.title: Controllers & Subscription Gate
tour.description: One level deeper in the API layer, thin REST controllers translate HTTP into domain calls: SaleController handles sales, refunds, credit payments and till stats; CustomerController manages khata customers; ProductController handles the catalogue. The EnsureSubscribed middleware sits in front of all of them, returning a 402 trial_expired payload when the shop's subscription lapses — the enforcement point for the product's business model.

tour.title: POS Domain Services
tour.description: The real business rules live in the service layer beneath the controllers. SaleService rings up sales and refunds inside a single row-locked DB transaction — resolving priced lines, applying discounts and posting audited stock movements. SalePaymentService settles credit-sale debt with single-sale instalments and oldest-first lump-sum allocation, and DayBookService implements the open/close till-day lifecycle with expected-cash computation and automatic ledger postings.
tour.languageLesson: Laravel services use DB::transaction with row locking (lockForUpdate) so concurrent till operations cannot double-spend stock or double-allocate a debt payment — the invariant lives in the service, not the controller.

tour.title: Khata: The Udhaar Credit Ledger
tour.description: Khata is the product's differentiator: customers.html plus js/customers.js give each customer a page showing outstanding balance, credit limit, ledger and payment history, with payment recording. On the backend, the Customer model computes derived balances over open sales, and SalePayment rows form the audit trail behind every settlement. docs/features/khata-udhaar.md explains the model, including how walk-in sales are resolved to real customers.

tour.title: Database Schema
tour.description: The MySQL schema underpins everything above: the sales table holds POS headers (reference, totals, payment method, tendered/change), customers holds the per-shop khata ledger with credit limits, sale_payments records each instalment with recorder attribution, stock_movements is the audited trail behind every inventory change, and day_balances stores each till day's opening/closing/expected cash. Notice the deliberate design: stock only changes via audited movements, and balances are derived rather than stored.
tour.languageLesson: Deriving khata balances from sales + sale_payments rows instead of storing a mutable balance column keeps the ledger auditable — you can always reconstruct who owes what and why.

tour.title: Offline-First Selling
tour.description: Shops lose connectivity, so the till is designed to keep selling offline. js/offline-db.js is an IndexedDB wrapper holding a mirrored product catalog with locally adjusted stock plus an outbound sale queue, and js/sync.js drains that outbox — replaying queued sales through an injected sender and classifying each HTTP outcome. docs/features/offline-sync.md candidly documents which parts are finished versus still unwired.
tour.languageLesson: The outbox pattern — persist intent locally first, replay to the server later — makes sync.js testable by injecting a sender function, a small dependency-injection trick that avoids mocking fetch globally.

tour.title: Billing & Subscription (Paddle)
tour.description: The subscription model that gates the till: SubscriptionService manages plan lifecycle and the 7-day trial, PaddleGateway wraps the Paddle merchant-of-record API, and PaddleWebhookController verifies signatures and dedupes inbound webhook events — the only path allowed to move subscription state. On the frontend, js/billing.js drives the checkout and status page. Note the locked decision: shop money is PKR, subscription money is USD.

tour.title: Mobile Shell (Capacitor)
tour.description: The same web app ships as a native shell via Capacitor: capacitor.config.json packages webDir into the Android/iOS apps. mobile/index.html is the packaged entry with a splash screen and pre-paint theme boot, mobile/js/shell.js is the shared per-screen shell that gates on the auth token and syncs the native status bar, and mobile/js/sell.js is a thumb-first mobile till reusing the same API.

tour.title: Testing & QA Harness
tour.description: The project is guarded by three tiers of tests. tests/cart.test.js and siblings run pure-logic unit tests on the Node test runner; backend PHPUnit suites like CustomerKhataTest.php exercise the API feature-by-feature (365 tests); and the offline QA harness — scripts/qa-milestone.mjs driven by e2e/playwright.config.js — boots both servers and replays cumulative milestone E2E specs, with phpunit.xml defining the Laravel test environment.
tour.languageLesson: The milestone-cumulative Playwright config maps QA_MILESTONE to a growing spec-file list, so gating milestone Mx automatically re-runs every earlier milestone — regression coverage compounds for free.
